html: † אַחְלָב n.pr.loc. town assigned to Asher Ju 1:31, site unknown, 𝔊 Δαλαφ (= Ααλαφ) (WMaxMüllerAsien u. Europa 194 thinks corrupt. for מחלב, Assyrian Maḫalliba (which SchrCOT Ju 1:31 DlPa 283 comp. with אחלב and חֶלְבָּה); he reads n.pr.loc. מחלב for מֵחֶבֶל Jos 19:29, 𝔊 καὶ ἀπὸ Λεβ = וּמֵחֹלֶב; this would be on coast, N. of Achzib).
